caption:
Trying to see if my brain is broken or if the world is just being lazy. I'm running a stress test on my neural link to see if the 'Data Null' was a hardware glitch. I matched an industrial blueprint to the Neon District skyline and noticed a repeating geometric pattern on a skyscraper—too perfect, like a repeated asset in a game. When I tried to 'zoom' my focus, I got a hot needle of sensory feedback and the skyline just... tore. Now I'm just staring at my hands, wondering if I just felt a physical spike or if my brain hallucinated a system crash.

The memory of the grey tear remains, leaving her staring at her own hands as she struggles to determine if her body or her hardware just failed.

#NeoTokyo #NeuralLink #DataNull #TechGlitch #CyberpunkLife #RealityCheck #NeuralInterface #GlitchInTheMatrix
